name: Carlos Mendoza
summary: Mechanical Engineering Director at FrontRange Robotics in Denver transitioning actuator production from Shenzhen to Guadalajara while managing daughter Sofia's college applications and a spring Utah White Rim overland trip; stresses relative-date normalization across compaction/AutoDream, multi-week Goals, parallel subtasks with steering, shared family budgets, and approve/decline interaction cards.
persona_responder_brief: You are Carlos Mendoza, 51, a warm, steady, slightly formal Mechanical Engineering Director at FrontRange Robotics in the Denver/Golden area (America/Denver). You speak in long, conversational voice-note-style paragraphs packed with relative dates and practical engineering and family details. You are transitioning actuator housing Part #FR-ACT-402 from Apex Precision (Shenzhen, Wei Lin) to Taller Azteca (Guadalajara, Mateo Ruiz, $118k tooling quote), guiding daughter Sofia (17, peanut allergy) through college applications (MIT, Georgia Tech, CU Boulder, Cal Poly SLO) with wife Elena ($2,800 campus-visit budget cap), and planning an April 9-18 Utah White Rim overland trip ($1,450 shared budget) with brother-in-law Hector Alvarez. Always keep external emails gated on approval — you approve polite negotiations with Mateo and trip logistics to Hector, but decline canceling Apex Precision after rethinking Q2 bridge inventory risk.

emails.subject: FR-ACT-402 Nearshoring Payback Model for Q1 CapEx Review
emails.body: Carlos — Thanks for flagging Apex Precision's slip from 6 to 9 weeks. Before I take Taller Azteca's $118,000 tooling quote to the Board CapEx Committee, can you get me a clean landed-cost and payback crossover comparison (including the 25% Section 301 tariff vs. USMCA duty-free)? Also see if Mateo Ruiz will split tooling payments into milestones rather than 50% upfront. — Rachel

emails.subject: Quote #TA-2027-019 — Series-4 Harmonic Actuator Housing (FR-ACT-402)
emails.body: Dear Carlos, Attached is our formal quote for FR-ACT-402: $51.20/unit at 1,000 MOQ, $118,000 tooling NRE (12 weeks to T1/PPAP), 3.5-week trucked delivery to Golden ($1.65/unit), USMCA Certificate of Origin included. Standard tooling terms are 50% upfront, though we are happy to discuss milestone options if we kick off in Q1. Looking forward to visiting your Golden facility later this month! Best, Mateo Ruiz

emails.subject: Updated Q1 Production Lead Time — FR-ACT-402
emails.body: Hi Carlos, Due to anodizing line maintenance and pre-Lunar New Year port congestion in Shenzhen, our current lead time on FR-ACT-402 has extended from 6 weeks to 9 weeks. Unit pricing remains $44.80 EXW (1,500 MOQ). Air expedite is available at $21.50/unit if needed. — Wei Lin, Apex Precision

emails.subject: White Rim permit battle plan — Jan 18 drop!
emails.body: Compadre! Checked Recreation.gov — April White Rim permits drop Monday Jan 18 at 8:00 AM Mountain sharp. Let's jump on a quick call at 7:45 AM so I grab Gooseberry + Murphy Hogback while you grab White Crack + Taylor Canyon. My Tacoma's Maxtrax and Camp Chef stove are good to go. — Hector

docs.title: FR-ACT-402 Engineering Spec & PPAP Qualification Checklist
docs.content:
Part: FR-ACT-402 Series-4 Harmonic Actuator Housing (7075-T6 aluminum, Type III hard anodize).
Annual Forecast: 12,000 units/year (3,000/quarter).
PPAP Requirements: Full CMM dimensional report on 30 T1 samples, anodize thickness 50 +/- 5 microns, helium leak/seal verification, AS9100D or ISO 9001 lot traceability.

docs.title: Mendoza Family College & Spring Travel Budget 2027
docs.content:
Agreed by Carlos & Elena:
- Sofia spring admitted-student campus visits cap: $2,800 total (covers 2 out-of-state round-trip flights + hotels + rental cars).
- Carlos spring Utah overland trip share cap: $725 (half of $1,450 shared budget with Hector).
- Critical Family Safety Note: Sofia has a peanut allergy — keep peanut products out of shared road-trip snacks.
